title: Tsiang Ya Ying

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No.......... 9
Date.... 1 - 2 - 16
February 7th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a high military officer named
Tsiang Ya Ying 蔣雁行 arrived here some days ago from
Peking and is now staying with the Deputy Military Governor,
General Lu Yoong Ziang. It is reported that the Central
Government has specially sent Tsiang here to assist his
host in watching the Military Governor, General Yang.
It is reported that the rebels here have written to
Sun Yat Sen saying that they will be ready to start by the
15th inst. The rebels intend to notify the Consulates a
few days before they start the rising.
It is reported that some rebel officers who reside in the
western part of Frenchtown have dispatched a letter to Sun
Yat Sen saying that they will be ready to rise by the 15th
inst. The letter explains that General Lu the Deputy
Military Governor stationed at Woosung is the only serious
opponent of the rebels in Shanghai and that he can be easily
dealt with if the necessary funds are forthcoming. The
letter urges Sun Yat Sen to send as much money as he can
with all possible haste. The letter was drafted near
Loo Ka Wei 陸家渡and was dispatched on 1st February 1916.
It was signed by Wong Tsah Ming 王□明 who is alleged to be
the local leader of the anti-Yuan army. Wong was a military
officer in Nanking during the second revolution.
With reference to the above it is said that the rebels
will notify the various Consulates a few days before they
start the rising in Shanghai.
It is reported that the rebels are negotiating with the
Mitsui Bussen Kaisha No.49 Szechuen Road with a view to
chartering a ship for military purposes.
It is reported that a censor has memorialised the Central
Government to the effect that the troops under General Yang
the Military Governor of Shanghai are 10 per cent short of
the number which they are purported to be on the pay sheets.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmimmmmusting
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：）
TS
Seen by C.I.P.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海公共租界工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
编号.......... 9
日期.... 1 - 2 - 16
1916年2月7日

先生：

据报，一位名为蒋雁行的高级军官数日前从北京抵达此处，现正与副督军卢永祥将军同住。据报，中央政府特派蒋氏来此，协助其东道主监视督军杨将军。

据报，此地的反叛者已致信孙中山，称他们将于本月15日前准备就绪发动起义。反叛者打算在发动起义前几天通知各领事馆。

据报，一些居住在法租界西部的反叛军官已派遣一封信给孙中山，称他们将于本月15日前准备就绪发动起义。信中解释称，驻防吴淞的副督军卢将军是反叛者在上海唯一的强劲对手，如果能有必要资金到位，便可轻易将其处置。信中敦促孙中山尽可能快地汇寄越多资金越好。该信起草于陆家渡附近，并于1916年2月1日发出。信件由王□明签署，据称他是反袁军队的本地领导人。王氏在二次革命期间曾是南京的一名军官。

关于上述情况，据说反叛者将在上海发动起义前几天通知各领事馆。

据报，反叛者正与位于四川路49号的三井物产株式会社进行谈判，意图包租一艘船只用于军事目的。

据报，一名监察官员已向中央政府上奏，称上海督军杨将军麾下的部队人数比薪饷名册上声称的人数短缺百分之十。

您顺从的仆人，
mmimmmmusting
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监。

（左侧手写批注：）
TS
刑事侦缉处长阅
